decision_table.name: Determine_NV_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Nevada Commerce Tax return. Checks for physical presence, economic nexus, and revenue threshold.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in Nevada (office, employees, property)

condition.name: has_economic_nexus
condition.comment: Meets Nevada economic nexus threshold ($100K or 200 transactions)

rule.policy:
Nevada Commerce Tax: No tax due (Nevada gross revenue below $4M threshold).
Nevada has NO corporate income tax.
The Commerce Tax only applies to businesses with Nevada-sitused gross revenue exceeding $4,000,000. Below this threshold, no Commerce Tax is due.
Note: Business license fees and modified business tax (payroll tax) may still apply but are separate from Commerce Tax.
Reference: NRS 363C.100 - Commerce Tax Threshold Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Exemptions Reference: Form CT-1 (Commerce Tax Return)

actions.action: // Physical nexus and above threshold - Commerce Tax required result.nv_qualifies_for_exemption = false;

rule.policy:
Nevada Commerce Tax filing required due to physical presence and revenue exceeding $4M.
Physical presence includes: - Office or place of business in Nevada - Employees working in Nevada - Tangible property in Nevada - Nevada entity (organized under Nevada law) - Registered to do business in Nevada
The Commerce Tax is calculated on Nevada-sitused gross revenue exceeding $4M.
Reference: NRS 363C.040 - Nexus Reference: NRS 363C.100 - Tax Imposition Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Calculation

actions.action: // Economic nexus and above threshold - Commerce Tax required result.nv_qualifies_for_exemption = false;

rule.policy:
Nevada Commerce Tax filing required due to economic nexus.
Economic nexus threshold (either): - $100,000 or more in Nevada-sourced receipts, OR - 200 or more separate transactions in Nevada
Nevada adopted economic nexus following South Dakota v. Wayfair (2018).
Reference: NRS 363C.040 - Economic Nexus Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018)

No Nevada nexus - no Commerce Tax filing requirement.
Corporation does not have: - Physical presence in Nevada - $100,000 or more in Nevada receipts - 200 or more Nevada transactions
Any estimated payments would be refunded.
Reference: NRS 363C.040 - Nexus Requirements

decision_table.name: Calculate_NV_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Nevada has NO corporate income tax. This table confirms zero income tax liability for consistency with framework.

rule.policy:
Nevada has NO corporate income tax.
Nevada does NOT tax corporate net income. Instead, Nevada imposes: - Commerce Tax: Gross receipts tax on revenue exceeding $4M - Modified Business Tax: Payroll tax on employee compensation - Business License Fee: Annual fee for doing business in Nevada
This decision table confirms zero income tax for framework consistency.
The Commerce Tax (gross receipts tax) is calculated separately by table 54080.
Reference: NRS 363C - Commerce Tax (NOT an income tax) Reference: Nevada does not have NRS chapter for corporate income tax (none exists) Reference: Nevada Constitution Article 10 - No state income tax
No Nevada nexus - no tax liability.

decision_table.name: Determine_NV_Business_Classification
decision_table.description: Determine Nevada business classification for Commerce Tax rate. Sets appropriate Commerce Tax rate based on industry (NAICS code).

actions.action: // Financial Services: 0.331% (highest rate) result.nv_commerce_tax_rate = result.nv_financial_services_rate;

rule.policy:
Nevada Commerce Tax - Financial Services: 0.331%
NAICS Code 52 - Finance and Insurance This includes banks, credit unions, securities dealers, insurance carriers, and other financial institutions.
This is the highest Commerce Tax rate classification.
Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates Reference: NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification

actions.action: // Mining: 0.262% result.nv_commerce_tax_rate = result.nv_mining_rate;

rule.policy:
Nevada Commerce Tax - Mining: 0.262%
NAICS Code 21 - Mining, Quarrying, and Oil and Gas Extraction Includes metal ore mining, coal mining, oil and gas extraction, and mining support.
Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates Reference: NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification

actions.action: // Utilities: 0.266% result.nv_commerce_tax_rate = result.nv_utilities_rate;

rule.policy:
Nevada Commerce Tax - Utilities: 0.266%
NAICS Code 22 - Utilities Includes electric power, natural gas, water, and sewage utilities.
Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates Reference: NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification

actions.action: // Professional Services: 0.128% result.nv_commerce_tax_rate = result.nv_professional_services_rate;

rule.policy:
Nevada Commerce Tax - Professional, Scientific, Technical Services: 0.128%
NAICS Code 54 - Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services Includes legal, accounting, engineering, consulting, computer systems design, and other professional services.
Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates Reference: NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification

actions.action: // Retail Trade: 0.091% result.nv_commerce_tax_rate = result.nv_retail_trade_rate;

rule.policy:
Nevada Commerce Tax - Retail Trade: 0.091%
NAICS Codes 44-45 - Retail Trade Includes motor vehicle dealers, furniture stores, electronics stores, food and beverage stores, and other retail establishments.
Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates Reference: NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification

actions.action: // Manufacturing: 0.091% result.nv_commerce_tax_rate = result.nv_manufacturing_rate;

rule.policy:
Nevada Commerce Tax - Manufacturing: 0.091%
NAICS Codes 31-33 - Manufacturing Includes production of goods from raw materials through fabrication, processing, assembling, and packaging.
Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates Reference: NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification

actions.action: // Wholesale Trade: 0.101% result.nv_commerce_tax_rate = result.nv_wholesale_trade_rate;

rule.policy:
Nevada Commerce Tax - Wholesale Trade: 0.101%
NAICS Code 42 - Wholesale Trade Includes merchant wholesalers, agents and brokers selling goods to retailers, business/institutional customers, or other wholesalers.
Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates Reference: NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification

actions.action: // Other Services: 0.051% (lowest rate) result.nv_commerce_tax_rate = result.nv_other_rate;

rule.policy:
Nevada Commerce Tax - Other Services: 0.051% (lowest rate)
Catch-all classification for business activities not specifically classified in other NAICS categories.
Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates Reference: NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification

decision_table.name: Calculate_NV_Sitused_Revenue
decision_table.description: Calculate Nevada-sitused gross revenue for Commerce Tax. Uses market-based sourcing to determine revenue attributable to Nevada.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate Nevada sitused revenue

condition.name: has_apportionment_percentage
condition.comment: Has calculated apportionment percentage to Nevada

rule.policy:
Nevada sitused revenue calculation for Commerce Tax:
Nevada uses market-based sourcing (destination-based) to determine what revenue is sitused to Nevada:
- Sales of tangible property: Destination state (where delivered to customer) - Services: Where customer receives benefit (location of customer) - Intangible property/licenses: Where customer uses intangible (customer location) - Rental income: Location of rented property
Only revenue sitused to Nevada is subject to Commerce Tax.
The $4M threshold applies to Nevada-sitused revenue only (not total worldwide revenue).
Reference: NRS 363C.100 - Situsing Gross Revenue Reference: NAC 363C.200 - Situsing Rules Reference: NAC 363C.220 - Market-Based Sourcing
No apportionment percentage calculated - treating all receipts as Nevada-sitused. This is conservative approach when apportionment data is unavailable.

actions.action: result.nv_sitused_revenue = 0.0; result.nv_gross_revenue = 0.0;

rule.policy: No Nevada nexus - no revenue sitused to Nevada.

decision_table.name: Calculate_NV_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate Nevada Commerce Tax liability. Applies Commerce Tax rate to Nevada-sitused gross revenue exceeding $4M.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe Commerce Tax

condition.name: exceeds_threshold
condition.comment: Nevada gross revenue meets or exceeds $4M threshold

rule.policy:
Nevada Commerce Tax Calculation:
IMPORTANT: Nevada has NO corporate income tax. The Commerce Tax is a gross receipts tax, NOT an income tax.
1. Nevada-sitused gross revenue: [Revenue sourced to Nevada] 2. Commerce Tax threshold: - $4,000,000 3. Taxable revenue: = [Excess over threshold] 4. Business classification: [financial/mining/retail/professional/etc.] 5. Commerce Tax rate: [0.051% to 0.331% based on industry] 6. Commerce Tax before credits: = [Taxable revenue × Rate] 7. Credits: - [Renewable energy, data center, film, aviation, etc.] 8. Commerce Tax liability: = [Final tax]
Key Differences from Income Tax: - Based on GROSS RECEIPTS (revenue), not net income - No deductions for expenses, COGS, or operating costs - $4M threshold (only revenue above $4M is taxed) - Very low rates (0.051%-0.331%) but on gross revenue - Must be paid even if business operates at a loss
Available Credits: - Renewable energy credits - Data center tax abatements - Film production credits - Aviation and aerospace credits - Transferable tax credits (allowed under NRS 363C.150)
Reference: NRS 363C.100 - Commerce Tax Imposition Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates by Industry Reference: NRS 363C.150 - Credits Reference: Form CT-1 - Commerce Tax Return Reference: Nevada Tax Commission - Commerce Tax Information Guide

No Nevada Commerce Tax due - Nevada-sitused revenue below $4M threshold.
Nevada has NO corporate income tax.
The Commerce Tax only applies to businesses with Nevada-sitused gross revenue exceeding $4,000,000. Revenue below this threshold is exempt from Commerce Tax.
Note: Other Nevada taxes may still apply: - Business License Fee (annual fee) - Modified Business Tax (payroll tax on wages) - Sales and Use Tax (on retail sales)
These are separate from Commerce Tax and calculated independently.
Any estimated Commerce Tax payments would be refunded.
Reference: NRS 363C.100 - $4M Threshold Exemption Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Calculation

No Nevada nexus - no Commerce Tax liability.
Corporation does not have: - Physical presence in Nevada - $100,000 or more in Nevada receipts - 200 or more Nevada transactions
Any estimated payments are refunded.
Reference: NRS 363C.040 - Nexus Requirements
